title: Pure Materiactor
summary: The pure Materiactor Rank 3 Xyz build with Prima Materiactor and a full Rank 3 Extra Deck. The strategy revolves around Level 3 Normal Monsters, attaching cards from the Deck and Pendulum Zone as Xyz Materials and bouncing those materials back to your hand on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Starters
points: Materiactor Exareptor reveals itself and discards a card to search a Level 3 Normal Monster (Prima Materiactor) and Special Summon itself from the hand.
Materiactor Zeptwing Special Summons itself while you control a Materiactor card, searches a Materiactor card, and revives or summons a Level 3 Normal Monster.
Materiactor Gigadra discards a card to Special Summon a Level 3 Normal Monster from the hand or Deck, or any Materiactor monster if you discarded a Normal Monster.

summary.title: Opening: Exareptor into Exagard & Gigaboros
steps: Reveal Materiactor Exareptor in hand and discard a card to search Prima Materiactor and Special Summon Exareptor.
Normal Summon Prima Materiactor (or activate Materiactor Meltthrough to pay 1500 LP and Xyz Summon using a single Level 3 Normal Monster) and overlay into Rank 3 Materiactor Exagard.

Detach a material from Exagard to Special Summon Materiactor Zeptwing from the Deck; Zeptwing searches Materiactor Critical and revives Prima Materiactor for a second Rank 3 such as Materiactor Gigaboros.

summary.title: Prima Materiactor & Material Bouncing
summary.text: Prima Materiactor is a Level 3 Pendulum Normal Monster: in the hand, Deck, and GY it satisfies every Level 3 Normal Monster check, while in the Pendulum Zone it attaches itself to a Materiactor Xyz Monster to draw a card. When the opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster, Materiactor Exagard returns up to 2 materials to the owner's hand (including any handtraps attached from the top of your Deck via Materiactor Meltdown) and bounces a card on the field if a Normal Monster is in your GY.

summary.title: Control & Rank 3 Toolbox
points: Materiactor Gigaboros detaches a material to attach a Materiactor from the Deck, gains 500 ATK/DEF per material, and adds an attached card to your hand during the opponent's Main Phase.
Materiactor Critical is a searchable Counter Trap that returns an Xyz Material from a Materiactor Xyz to your hand to negate any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation.

Number 75: Bamboozling Gossip Shadow, Ashura King, and Crowned Siclavee round out the Rank 3 Extra Deck, since Materiactor Gigadra and Materiactor Meltthrough lock your Extra Deck summons to Xyz Monsters.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Speedroid, Phantom Knights, Armored Xyz, and Fiendsmith hybrid packages are omitted to keep the build pure Materiactor.
